# Roznamcha (روزنامچہ)

> Roznamcha is a modern, Urdu-first shop daily journal and accounting system for small businesses in Pakistan.

## Overview

Roznamcha (meaning "daily journal" in Urdu) is a web-based accounting application designed for shopkeepers and small business owners. It provides an intuitive, right-to-left (RTL) interface in Urdu for managing daily financial transactions, customer records, expenses, and invoices.

All data is stored locally in the browser using IndexedDB — no server, no sign-up, no internet required after first load.

## Key Features

- **Daily Journal (روزنامچہ)**: Record daily transactions with customer names, cash amounts, payments, receipts, and balances
- **Dashboard**: Overview of financial summaries and charts
- **Customer Management**: Track customer records and transaction history
- **Expense Tracking**: Log and categorize daily business expenses
- **Invoice Generation**: Create and export professional invoices as PDF
- **Remaining Balances (بقایا جات)**: Track outstanding amounts and receivables
- **Data Backup & Restore**: Export/import data as JSON for safekeeping
- **Recycle Bin**: Recover accidentally deleted entries
- **Dark/Light Theme**: Full theme support with system preference detection
- **Offline-First**: Works entirely offline after initial load — all data stored in IndexedDB

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 7
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v3 with shadcn/ui components
- **State Management**: Jotai (atomic state)
- **Routing**: React Router v7
- **Storage**: IndexedDB (browser-local, no backend)
- **PDF Export**: jsPDF, @react-pdf/renderer
- **Charts**: Recharts, Chart.js
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Fonts**: Noto Nastaliq Urdu (Urdu text), Inter (numbers/Latin)
- **Deployment**: Vercel
- **Analytics**: Vercel Analytics & Speed Insights

## Pages

| Route | Page | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `/` | Redirect | Redirects to Dashboard |
| `/dashboard` | Dashboard | Financial overview with summary cards and charts |
| `/roznamcha` | Daily Journal | Main transaction register — add, edit, delete daily entries |
| `/invoice` | Invoice | Generate and export invoices |
| `/expenses` | Expenses | Track and manage business expenses |
| `/customers` | Customers | Customer directory and transaction history |
| `/remainings` | Remaining Balances | Outstanding amounts and receivables tracking |
| `/backup` | Backup | Export/import data as JSON backup files |
| `/recycle` | Recycle Bin | View and restore deleted entries |
| `/settings` | Settings | Theme, language, and app configuration |

## Data Model

Roznamcha uses IndexedDB with the following core data structure:

- **Journal Entry**: Serial number, customer name, mobile number, cash amount, payment, receipt, balance, remaining amount, previous balance, notes, date
- **Customers**: Name, contact info, transaction history
- **Expenses**: Category, amount, date, description

## Language & Locale

- Primary language: Urdu (اردو)
- Text direction: Right-to-left (RTL)
- Number format: Standard Arabic numerals with Urdu labels
- Date display: Urdu-formatted dates via date-fns
